name: Registration of Herb Cultivators - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
benefit: Registration of farmers cultivating medicinal and aromatic plants, simplification of the extraction process for cultivated herbs, and prevention of illegal exploitation of herbal resources from forest areas.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a cultivator of medicinal and aromatic plants. 1. The applicant must either have their own resources on their measured land or be a cultivator encouraged by the Herbal Research and Development Institute, or a cultivator beneficiary supported by any other organization, institute, department, or voluntary organization.
